sloka: उच्यताम् गच्छ सुग्रीवः त्वया वीरः महाबल ।मम रोषस्य यत् रूपम् ब्रूयाः च एनम् इदम् वचः ॥४-३०-७९॥
transliteration: ucyatām gaccha sugrīvaḥ tvayā vīraḥ mahābala ।mama roṣasya yat rūpam brūyāḥ ca enam idam vacaḥ ॥4-30-79॥

translations.english: 'Sporting with the council of ministers surrounding him, resorting to drinking, he shows no compassion to us feeling wretched with grief.
